div.head: Duns 8.3
div.ab: Si quis trans flumen propriare sibi uelit, tunc erit hoc per ordalium.
Gif hit man begeondan str[e]ame agnian wylle, ðone sceal þæt beon mid ordale.
If the man on the other side of the stream [he who seized the cattle] wants to retain them, then that shall be [only possible] through the ordeal.
Wenn jemand jenseits des Stromes [gegen diesseitigen Anefänger] es als sein Ureigen behaupten will, dann soll dies [nur] durch Ordal [ihm möglich] sein.
If anyone beyond the river wishes to claim it as his own property [against the attacher on this side], then this shall be [possible for him only] by ordeal.
